label: coach of
definition: X is or was a coach of team, school or sporting program Y.
scope_notes: Preserves the previous coach predicate. Explicit coach role or coaching action qualifies, including a university/team named by its place. Mere athletic participation, ownership or general management does not.

facts.reason: Jackson is explicitly a Bulls coach and is said to coach Bulls.
The possessive coach construction identifies Sather as Rangers coach.
Calhoun is explicitly coach at/of Connecticut and coaches its program; team wording fixes the sporting use of the place name.
Auriemma is explicitly UConn coach; the separate winning-at row is insufficient alone.
Holtz is explicitly Notre Dame coach in several constructions; team and season context corroborates the program.
